sourceChecks.text: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: but he didn’t call Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Then Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, “Haven’t you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith reigns, and David our lord doesn’t know it?
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Behold, while she was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: They told the king, saying, “Behold, Nathan the prophet!” When he had come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Nathan said, “My lord, King, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne’?
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: King David said, “Call to me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada.” They came before the king.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel. Blow the trumpet, and say, ‘Long live King Solomon!’
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they have caused him to ride on the king’s mule.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon. They have come up from there rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that you have heard.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers; Zabud the son of Nathan was chief minister, the king’s friend;
